title: Ginabo Admin Command Center Memory
purpose: Catatan lanjutan agar issue admin dashboard / command center bisa diangkat kembali di hari berikutnya tanpa perlu mengulang analisis dari awal.

admin_command_center_summary.vision: Admin dashboard Ginabo diarahkan menjadi Business Operating System / Command Center, bukan dashboard statis.
admin_command_center_summary.core_goal: Semua modul admin berjalan otomatis dari data produksi Supabase, dengan KPI, alert, workflow operasional, dan rekomendasi berbasis data live.
admin_command_center_summary.current_state: Fondasi UI dan sebagian backend sudah tersedia, tetapi beberapa modul masih demo dan ada inkonsistensi skema data yang perlu dirapikan sebelum otomatisasi produksi stabil.

command_center_main.refresh_behavior: Auto-refresh every 60 seconds and when browser tab becomes visible.
command_center_main.data_source_switch: COMMAND_CENTER_DATA_SOURCE controls provider: empty/demo uses demo data, live uses Supabase live aggregation.
command_center_main.current_realtime_level: Near real-time polling, not full Supabase WebSocket subscription yet.

known_issues.title: Several admin intelligence modules still use demo-v2 directly
known_issues.details: Customer Intelligence, Logistics, Inventory Intelligence, Marketing Intelligence, Executive Dashboard, Skincare Intelligence, and Alert Center currently import data from demo-v2.ts inside client pages instead of calling live backend APIs.
known_issues.impact: UI exists, but modules are not truly automatic or production-live yet.
known_issues.recommended_next_step: Create live API endpoints and provider functions for each module, mirroring the command-center provider pattern.

known_issues.title: Schema naming is inconsistent between old types/API code and Supabase migrations
known_issues.details: Some code paths use fields like user_id, stock, phone, skin_concern, while migrations use profile_id, stock_quantity, phone_number, skin_concerns. Some legacy admin code also references AdminUser while Supabase migration uses admin_users.
known_issues.impact: Live automation can silently fail or calculate wrong values when code queries columns that do not exist in the production schema.
known_issues.recommended_next_step: Choose canonical Supabase schema naming from migrations, regenerate/update types, then refactor API routes to use the same names consistently.

known_issues.title: Command Center is polling, not full realtime
known_issues.details: CommandCenterDashboard refreshes every 60 seconds. Supabase realtime is enabled for some tables in migration 001, but the frontend command center does not subscribe directly yet.
known_issues.impact: Dashboard is automatic but not instant. Operational teams may see updates delayed up to 60 seconds.
known_issues.recommended_next_step: After schema cleanup, add Supabase realtime subscriptions or invalidation events for orders, products, returns, payments, bookings, and notifications.

known_issues.title: Alert Center is still demo-driven
known_issues.details: Alert Center currently uses getDemoAlertCenter from demo-v2.ts.
known_issues.impact: Critical alerts shown in UI are not guaranteed to reflect actual production risk.
known_issues.recommended_next_step: Build backend alert engine that derives alerts from live rules: delayed orders, low stock, return risk, refund spikes, courier delays, churn risk, payment failures, and inventory overstock.

known_issues.title: AI Advisor currently behaves like rule-based recommendation, not full AI pipeline
known_issues.details: Command Center live provider currently generates advisor actions from basic heuristics such as inventory risk, old orders, and risky returns.
known_issues.impact: Useful as an operational advisor, but not yet a full AI business advisor with summaries, forecasts, and natural-language business reasoning.
known_issues.recommended_next_step: Create an AI advisor pipeline that consumes clean aggregate snapshots and produces executive summaries, risk explanations, and recommended next actions.

module_live_backend_plan.next_backend_work: Harden live provider, fix schema names, add previous-period comparison, then add realtime invalidation.
Aggregate profiles, orders, returns, reviews, acquisition source, LTV, repeat purchase, churn risk, loyalty score, customer segment.
Aggregate order pipeline from order status, shipped_at, tracking_number, shipping_courier, delivery SLA, courier tracking data.
Calculate velocity from order_items, stock days remaining, reorder point, overstock, dead stock, estimated revenue at risk.
Aggregate return rate, refund rate, top returned products, top reasons, risk/fraud flags, trend data from returns and return_items.
Define marketing source tables/integration strategy for Meta, Google, TikTok, email, affiliate, influencer, referral, then calculate ROAS/CAC/LTV.
Aggregate finance, revenue, profit, cash flow, inventory value, growth, retention, refund, forecast, and executive insights.
Use skin_type and skin_concerns from profiles plus order_items/reviews to calculate skin segment value, product effectiveness, repeat purchase by skin type.
Create live alert rules, persist generated alerts if needed, mark read/unread, and expose role-aware alert feed.

recommended_execution_order: Audit and normalize Supabase schema usage across codebase.
Update database types to match actual Supabase migrations.
Fix critical API routes that use old column names, especially checkout, payment webhook, admin overview, admin me, inventory stock decrement.
Convert demo-only admin intelligence pages to API-backed provider pattern.
Build alert engine from live business rules.
Add background jobs/cron for recurring calculations and notifications.
Add Supabase realtime subscriptions or event-driven dashboard refresh.
Add AI Advisor on top of trusted aggregate snapshots.
notes_for_future_codex: Do not start by redesigning UI; UI already exists for many V2 modules.
Prioritize backend correctness and schema consistency.
Use the Supabase migrations as canonical truth unless user says production DB differs.
Be careful with legacy Prisma schema and old uppercase table names such as Customer, Order, AdminUser.
Before implementing automation, verify exact live Supabase table/column names and environment variables.
Do not remove demo mode immediately; keep it as fallback while introducing live providers.
